mbedtls library/ssl_tls.c:7573 (from coverage-exp34c-2026-10-part-a-curl-hostap-mbedtls-mosquitto): the FP rested on the length being 0 when the pointer is NULL; a library call with a null pointer and a zero length is still invalid through C23 (EXP34-C/2026-10-07/presets), so the correlation is not proof.

sqlite src/func.c:960 (from coverage-exp34c-2026-10-part-a-sqlite): the FP rested on the in-tree FuncDef entries for likeFunc; the SQL function context is an open input (the function's address escapes into a FuncDef, and sqlite3_user_data returns 0 for a null context under SQLITE_ENABLE_API_ARMOR), which is how the other sqlite labels on that shape read it.
